item.title: Patch: Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder: Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres
item.description:
Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder: exploited · fix: 1.1.22.0

First step: Update Openwave Messaging Webtop Media Transcoder to 1.1.22.0 or later.

Openwave Messaging Limited Webtop Media Transcoder contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that may allow an authenticated user to process and convert unintended document types if bypassing the Webmail experience.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2026-111793
